_note: A small, standalone family: Mongol-Turkic horse-nomads of the open steppe. Only one clean member (Orkhan); Steppe otherwise appears in CROSS-family blends authored with their partner families: Kypchan (13+17 Slavic x Steppe), Xiongan (9+17 Chinese x Steppe), Karakan (15+17 N.American x Steppe). Those blends should reflex their Steppe component from the theonym_set below. Base provides the concept inventory, morphology template, shared roots, the clanhold (decimal-host) title structure, and the Steppe theonym morph-set. Orthography is ASCII (kh/gh/ch/sh/ng; o/u for o-umlaut/u-umlaut).

phonology.palette: Mongol-Turkic: vowel harmony (back a/o/u vs front e/i); consonants kh, gh, ch, sh, ng, q, ts; diphthongs -ai/-ei; agglutinative suffixes -tai/-dai (having), -chi (doer), -khan, -gha; no initial consonant clusters.

sub_palette_notes.mongol_turkic: Steppe register: khan/khagan/noyan/baatar; the ovog (clan) and the decimal war-host (arban 10, zuun 100, mingghan 1000, tumen 10000); the ordu (mobile royal camp) and the ulus (nation/realm); shaman (bo) religion at the ovoo (sacred cairn).

phonology.phonotactics: CV/CVC, no initial clusters; vowel harmony; -ai/-ei diphthongs; final -n/-g/-r common.

lexicon_concepts._note: Same concept inventory as the other family bases; realized in the culture kit (with steppe-specific terms: steppe, gobi, herd, felt, airag).

shared_roots._note: Common Mongol-Turkic roots (common words and titles, allowed; theophoric built only on the morphed canon-forms below, never real steppe gods).

theonym_set._note: Steppe morphs of the Agrippan canon: phoneme-morphs through Mongol-Turkic phonology (vowel harmony; -ai/-tai endings; v>b). These are NOT real steppe gods (no Tengri, Erlik, Ulgen, Umai, Qormusta). Orkhan realizes them directly (Chaotically: DEMONIZING the One (Eterun) as the Tyrant-Sky and reviling the Lawful powers, while revering the Chaotic powers - supreme among them the Wild Storm-Sky, Tamendei); cross-family Steppe blends (Kypchan/Xiongan/Karakan) reflex their Steppe component from here, framed by their own alignments (a Lawful-leaning steppe realm such as Xiongan would instead revere Eterun as the ordered Eternal Heaven).

morphology_template.toponymic_suffixes: feature-named: -uul (mtn), -gol (river), -nuur (lake), -tal (steppe); the camp named for its khan ([khan]-yn Ordu); quality prefix Har-/Tsagaan- (black-/white-).
morphology_template.patronymic_form: father's name + -in (of); ovog (clan) name; animal/deed byname; -tai/-dai (having) and -chi (doer).

title_ladder_structure._note: ACKS 7 tiers, clanhold. Built on khan: khan (king) at kingdom, khagan (khan of khans) at empire over the Yeke Ulus (Great Nation); the decimal host (zuun/mingghan/tumen) supplies the middle tiers; the khural (chiefs' assembly) raises the khan. Tier->ruler-level mapping pending the ACKS lookup.

conventions.people_name_default: personal name + patronymic (father + -in) + ovog (clan); deed/animal byname or Baatar (hero) honor; order given-first.
conventions.transparent_vs_opaque: moderate-high; many names are transparent compounds.
